records.name: Perseverance MEDA RHS · Mars sol 100
records.provider: NASA Planetary Data System Atmospheres Node
records.spatial_relation: Perseverance rover observation within the Jezero mission region; catalogue coordinates mark a regional locator, not the rover's exact position for every sample.
records.summary: Derived local atmospheric relative humidity, reported with respect to ice.
records.use_limit: Sol 100 is after the sensor team's sol-80 recommendation. Self-heating can affect continuous-mode readings; this is atmospheric water vapour context, not soil water, ice, or a usable resource. The sol median (0.20 %RH) is no greater than the median of the reported per-row uncertainties (1.31 %RH).
records.quality_note: PDS fill values and non-finite samples are excluded. 0 rows were excluded by the sensor quality filter. This one-sol summary is displayed as context only and is not used for analogue scoring.

uncertainty.description: Median reported per-row RHS uncertainty; not an uncertainty interval for the sol median.

records.processing_method: One-sol median and p10–p90 summary from the current PDS derived/calibrated CSV product; raw CSV is not retained.

scope: Selected Mars sol 100 only; not a Mars climate normal or full rover traverse archive.
